title: Can wormholes have vanishing Love numbers?
summary: Wormholes are fascinating alternatives to black hole geometries. In this paper, we have studied a special case of wormhole solution in the context of $R=0$ spacetime. Our approximate analytical calculations show that under a strictly static axial gravitational perturbation of this spacetime, the magnetic-type tidal Love number (for $\ell=2$) vanishes if we keep the solution of the master equation up to linear order in the regularisation parameter of the geometry.
